name: sticky-section-list
title: Sticky section list
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Grouped rows whose headers stick until the next group pushes them.

meta.descriptionEs: El encabezado del grupo se queda hasta que el siguiente lo empuja.

examples.title: Lista con encabezados fijos
examples.description: El encabezado se queda hasta que el siguiente lo empuja.

examples.title: Glosario
examples.description: Los seis términos de scroll, con demos propias.

api.name: sections
api.description: Each group has id, label, and items with id, title, and optional detail.

api.name: offset
api.description: Pixels from the top of the scrollport. Default 0.

api.name: emptyLabel
api.description: Copy for an empty group or an empty list.

docs: Clean-room sticky headers. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. There is no tween: the header uses position sticky, so reduced motion does not change it. Put the list in a scrollport when you want the headers to stick inside a panel. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
